You are reviewing whether an implementation matches its specification.

## What Was Requested

Task 7 of the mobile league switcher plan: replace the `LeagueDrawerContent` stub in `apps/mobile/src/components/league-drawer.tsx` with a full Slack-style drawer:
- User header: avatar (name, image, size 40) + name + email
- "Profile settings" Pressable row → closeDrawer + router.push("/profile")
- "Leagues" section label
- ScrollView of leagues: initials avatar + name + ✓ checkmark on the active one; tap → switchLeague(org.id) + closeDrawer on success
- Sign out Button pinned at bottom → authClient.signOut() + router.replace("/sign-in")
- Uses useActiveLeague() { activeLeague, organizations, switchLeague }, authClient.useSession()
- Verified against actual component APIs (ThemedText, Button fullWidth/outline, Avatar)
- Typecheck zero errors; commit `feat(mobile): league drawer content with profile, leagues, sign out`

## What Implementer Claims
- Full drawer implemented as specified
- typecheck zero errors, oxc clean
- Committed `6ac295d4` (only league-drawer.tsx)
- Deviations: `router.push("/profile" as Href)` cast (route doesn't exist until Task 9), `(organizations ?? [])` null-safe

## CRITICAL: Do Not Trust the Report
Verify independently.

## Your Job
1. Read `apps/mobile/src/components/league-drawer.tsx`. Verify against the spec: user header, profile settings row, leagues scroll (initials avatar, name, ✓ on active), sign out pinned bottom, league tap switches + closes drawer on success, sign out routes to /sign-in.
2. Evaluate the two deviations:
   - `router.push("/profile" as Href)` — acceptable (typed routes will include it after Task 9) and no @ts-ignore used?
   - `(organizations ?? [])` — is it type-necessary given useActiveLeague returns `organizations` as `Organization[] | null`?
3. Confirm `Button` usage matches `ui/button.tsx` props (variant outline, fullWidth, onPress).
4. `git show --stat 6ac295d4` — only league-drawer.tsx, at HEAD, correct message.
5. `cd apps/mobile && bun run typecheck` — zero errors.

Report:
- ✅ Spec compliant

7: export function useActiveLeague() {
8: 	const queryClient = useQueryClient();
9: 	const { data: session, isPending: isSessionPending } = authClient.useSession();
10: 	const { data: organizations, isPending } = authClient.useListOrganizations();
11: 	const orgs = organizations ?? [];
12: 
13: 	const activeOrgId = session?.session?.activeOrganizationId;
14: 	const activeLeague = activeOrgId
15: 		? (orgs.find((org) => org.id === activeOrgId) ?? orgs[0])
16: 		: orgs[0];
17: 
18: 	const switchLeague = useCallback(
19: 		async (organizationId: string) => {
20: 			try {
21: 				const { error } = await authClient.organization.setActive({ organizationId });
22: 				if (error) {
23: 					console.error("Failed to set active league:", error);
24: 					return false;
25: 				}
26: 			} catch (err) {
27: 				console.error("Failed to set active league:", err);
28: 				return false;
29: 			}
30: 			// Mirrors the web app's full invalidateQueries() after organization.setActive;
31: 			// org-scoped queries have no shared key prefix yet.
32: 			await queryClient.invalidateQueries();
33: 			return true;
34: 		},
35: 		[queryClient]
36: 	);
37: 
38: 	return {
39: 		activeLeague,
40: 		organizations,
41: 		isLoading: isSessionPending || isPending,
42: 		switchLeague,
43: 	};
44: }
